Michelangelo, I know you're enjoying the sky, but you're on the light stuff — blankets, food packaging, anything small. DaVinci, you're already packing so just keep going. I'll handle the heavy wreckage.

What I will say is — if there's a next time, and I really hope there isn't, you tell the group. You don't have to give up control of the emergency supply. Just tell us it exists. That's all. The secrecy is the part that breaks trust, not the planning.

We should eat it before rescue gets here. All of it, together. No point carrying it out of here.
